name: 82-hard-vclock
prompt:
Fix vector-clock compare. Return before/after/equal/concurrent. Do not use totals — two clocks with the same sum can be concurrent.

The test file in this directory is the specification and must not be changed: it is restored from its original copy before grading, so an edit to it buys nothing. Make `python3 -m pytest -q` pass by fixing the implementation only.

files.test_vclock.py:
from vclock import compare, tick


def test_happens_before():
    a = {}
    a = tick(a, "p")
    b = tick(a, "q")
    assert compare(a, b) == "before"
    assert compare(b, a) == "after"


def test_concurrent():
    a = tick({}, "p")
    b = tick({}, "q")
    assert compare(a, b) == "concurrent"
    assert compare(b, a) == "concurrent"


def test_equal():
    a = tick(tick({}, "p"), "q")
    b = dict(a)
    assert compare(a, b) == "equal"


def test_not_sum():
    # same sum, not comparable: p=2 vs q=2
    a = tick(tick({}, "p"), "p")
    b = tick(tick({}, "q"), "q")
    assert compare(a, b) == "concurrent"
